Features

Everything you need for IRWCMS

Built specifically for Indian Railways measurement book workflows.

📊
Excel & CSV Upload
Upload .xlsx, .xls, or .csv files. Multi-sheet workbooks supported with a sheet picker.
📋
Measurement Book Fill
Auto-fills Particulars, N1, N2, N3, K, L, B, H, and Sign (+/−) row by row.
📈
Variation Statement Fill
Matches Item Numbers and fills Proposed Qty across Schedule A/B tabs automatically.
☁️
Cloud Measurement Builder
Build measurements online at irwcms.primerp.in and load them directly — no Excel needed.
➕
Append & Replace Mode
Add new rows after existing data or fill from row 1. Detected automatically.
⚡
6-Speed Fill Control
From 500ms per row (stable connections) to 1ms instant mode for bulk operations.
👁️
Live Preview + Qty Total
Review all rows and see the calculated total quantity before filling a single field.
⏹️
Stop Anytime
Hit Stop to abort a running fill mid-way. Progress is preserved.

How it works

Three steps to zero manual entry

From Excel to filled form in under a minute.

1
Open IRWCMS
Navigate to your bill measurement form on ircep.gov.in and open the measurement item.
2
Upload Excel
Click the extension icon, upload your .xlsx file, preview the rows and total quantity.
3
Click Fill Form
The extension fills every row automatically — Particulars, dimensions, and sign.
